June 16, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Royal Bank Of Canada increased its stake in Micron Technology Inc (MU) by 33.02% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Royal Bank Of Canada bought 849,115 shares as the company’s stock rose 27.87% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3.42 million shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $178.37M, up from 2.57 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Royal Bank Of Canada who had been investing in Micron Technology Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $67.53 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.61% or $0.95 during the last trading session, reaching $58.23. About 41.76 million shares traded. Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) has risen 108.46% since June 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 95.89% the S&P500.
